title: Jamestown Founded
description: The English founded Jamestown the first permanent colony in America.

title: Mayflower Compact Signed
description: The Pilgrims signed the Mayflower Compact aboard ship.

title: Harvard University Founded
description: Harvard became the first college in the American colonies.

title: Salem Witch Trials
description: Witch trials in Salem Massachusetts led to mass executions.

title: French and Indian War Begins
description: Britain and France fought for control of North America.

title: Stamp Act Passed
description: Parliament taxed the American colonies with the Stamp Act.

title: Boston Massacre
description: British soldiers fired on a crowd in Boston killing five people.

title: Boston Tea Party
description: Colonists dumped British tea into Boston Harbor.

title: Intolerable Acts Passed
description: Parliament punished Boston with the Coercive Acts.

title: Shots Heard Round the World
description: Fighting broke out at Lexington and Concord starting the Revolution.

title: Declaration of Independence
description: The colonies declared independence from Britain on July 4.

title: Winter at Valley Forge
description: Washington's army endured a brutal winter at Valley Forge.

title: Treaty of Paris Signed
description: Britain recognized American independence.

title: US Constitution Adopted
description: Delegates in Philadelphia approved the Constitution.

title: Bill of Rights Ratified
description: The first ten amendments were added to the Constitution.

title: Whiskey Rebellion
description: Farmers in Pennsylvania rebelled against a whiskey tax.

title: Louisiana Purchase
description: The United States bought Louisiana from France doubling its size.

title: Lewis and Clark Expedition
description: The Corps of Discovery set out to explore the American West.

title: Steamboat Clermont Sails
description: Robert Fulton's steamboat steamed up the Hudson River.

title: Erie Canal Opens
description: The Erie Canal linked the Great Lakes to the Hudson River.

title: Indian Removal Act Passed
description: The Act forced Native American tribes to leave their lands.

title: McCormick Reaper Patented
description: Cyrus McCormick patented a mechanical reaper for wheat.

title: Texas Declares Independence
description: Texas declared independence from Mexico at the Alamo.

title: Trail of Tears
description: Cherokee people were forced to march west in deadly conditions.

title: California Gold Rush
description: Gold was discovered at Sutter's Mill in California.

title: Seneca Falls Convention
description: Reformers demanded women's rights at Seneca Falls.

title: Compromise of 1850
description: New laws tried to settle the slavery debate after the Mexican War.

title: Uncle Tom's Cabin Published
description: Harriet Beecher Stowe's novel fueled the anti-slavery movement.

title: Fugitive Slave Act Passed
description: The Act required the return of escaped enslaved people.

title: Kansas-Nebraska Act
description: The Act reopened the slavery question in western territories.

title: Dred Scott Decision
description: The Supreme Court ruled against Dred Scott's freedom.

title: Lincoln Elected President
description: Abraham Lincoln won the presidency without southern support.

title: Civil War Begins
description: Confederate forces attacked Fort Sumter starting the Civil War.

title: Emancipation Proclamation
description: Lincoln freed enslaved people in the Confederacy.

title: Battle of Gettysburg
description: The largest battle of the Civil War was fought at Gettysburg.

title: Gettysburg Address
description: Lincoln delivered his famous address at Gettysburg.

title: Civil War Ends
description: Robert E. Lee surrendered at Appomattox.

title: Lincoln Assassinated
description: John Wilkes Booth shot President Lincoln.

title: Thirteenth Amendment Ratified
description: The Amendment abolished slavery in the United States.

title: Transcontinental Railroad Completed
description: The golden spike joined the nation's first transcontinental railroad.

title: Alexander Graham Bell Patents Telephone
description: Bell patented the telephone in 1876.

title: Edison Demos Light Bulb
description: Thomas Edison demonstrated a practical incandescent lamp.

title: Haymarket Riot
description: A labor rally in Chicago turned violent.

title: Statue of Liberty Dedicated
description: The Statue of Liberty was dedicated in New York Harbor.

title: Wounded Knee Massacre
description: US troops killed Lakota people at Wounded Knee.

title: First Powered Flight
description: The Wright brothers flew at Kitty Hawk on December 17.

title: Model T Introduced
description: Ford launched the Model T automobile.

title: NAACP Founded
description: Activists founded the NAACP to fight racial injustice.

title: Titanic Sinks
description: The Titanic struck an iceberg and sank in the Atlantic.

title: Federal Reserve Created
description: Congress created the Federal Reserve System.

title: Zimmermann Telegram Intercepted
description: The telegram helped push the United States into World War I.

title: United States Enters World War I
description: Congress declared war on Germany.

title: Prohibition Enacted
description: The Eighteenth Amendment banned alcohol nationwide.

title: Woman Suffrage Amendment
description: Women won the right to vote with the Nineteenth Amendment.

title: Scopes Monkey Trial
description: John Scopes was tried for teaching evolution.

title: Stock Market Crash
description: Wall Street crashed starting the Great Depression.

title: Dust Bowl
description: Huge dust storms devastated the Great Plains.

title: Social Security Act
description: The Act created old-age benefits and unemployment insurance.

title: Golden Gate Bridge Opens
description: The Golden Gate Bridge opened in San Francisco.

title: Nylon Introduced
description: DuPont unveiled nylon at the World's Fair.

title: Pearl Harbor Attack
description: Japan attacked Pearl Harbor bringing America into World War II.

title: Japanese Internment Begins
description: The government imprisoned Japanese Americans in camps.

title: Manhattan Project Test
description: The first atomic bomb was tested at Trinity site.

title: United States Joins the UN
description: The UN Charter was ratified in San Francisco.

title: Amelia Earhart Disappears
description: Earhart vanished over the Pacific on a round-the-world flight.

title: Rosie the Riveter Campaign
description: Women entered factories to support the war effort.

title: Jackie Robinson Breaks Barrier
description: Robinson became the first Black player in modern Major League Baseball.

title: Polaroid Camera Launched
description: Edwin Land sold the first instant camera.

title: Rock and Roll Emerges
description: Rock and roll music exploded across America.

title: Brown v. Board of Education
description: The Supreme Court banned school segregation.

title: Polio Vaccine Approved
description: Jonas Salk's vaccine was declared safe and effective.

title: Interstate Highway Act
description: Eisenhower signed the Interstate Highway Act.

title: NASA Founded
description: NASA began operations as the civilian space agency.

title: Greensboro Sit-Ins
description: Students staged sit-ins at a segregated Woolworth lunch counter.

title: Alan Shepard Flies to Space
description: Shepard became the first American in space.

title: March on Washington
description: Martin Luther King Jr. delivered his I Have a Dream speech.

title: Kennedy Assassinated
description: President Kennedy was shot in Dallas.

title: Civil Rights Act
description: The Act outlawed segregation and discrimination.

title: Voting Rights Act
description: The Act protected the right to vote for Black Americans.

title: First American Spacewalk
description: Ed White walked in space during Gemini 4.

title: First Super Bowl
description: The Packers beat the Chiefs in the first Super Bowl.

title: Martin Luther King Jr. Assassinated
description: King was killed in Memphis.

title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
description: Neil Armstrong walked on the Moon.

title: First Earth Day
description: Millions took part in the first Earth Day.

title: Watergate Break-In
description: Burglars were caught at the Watergate complex.

title: Roe v. Wade Decided
description: The Supreme Court recognized a right to abortion.

title: Sony Walkman Released
description: Sony introduced the personal cassette player.

title: MTV Launches
description: MTV went on the air with music videos.

title: Challenger Disaster
description: The space shuttle Challenger broke apart after launch.

title: Reagan at the Berlin Wall
description: Reagan told Gorbachev to tear down the Berlin Wall.

title: World Wide Web Goes Public
description: Tim Berners-Lee shared the web with the public.

title: Los Angeles Riots
description: Riots erupted after the Rodney King verdict.

title: Dot-Com Bubble Peak
description: Technology stocks peaked before a market crash.

title: September 11 Attacks
description: Terrorists attacked the World Trade Center and the Pentagon.

title: Facebook Launches
description: Facebook started at Harvard University.

title: Hurricane Katrina
description: The hurricane devastated New Orleans.

title: Obama Elected President
description: Barack Obama became the first Black president.

title: Affordable Care Act
description: Obama signed the healthcare reform law.

title: Osama bin Laden Killed
description: US forces killed bin Laden in Pakistan.

title: Same-Sex Marriage Legalized
description: The Supreme Court recognized same-sex marriage nationwide.
